name: dungeon_lighting
note: Shared dark-dungeon lighting for map and characters (DESIGN.md 6). Intensities are lab slider units (x PI in three.js). Angles are relative to the fixed isometric camera: azimuthFromCamera 0 = at the camera, 180 = behind the subject; elevation in degrees above the horizon. rim = a directional back light plus rim.edge, a view-dependent silhouette glow added in the lab materials (a directional light barely reaches a 40 px silhouette); up-facing surfaces are masked so the floor is not lifted. Tuning notes: raise rim.edge.intensity before ambient.
